description: This file defines the WorkflowListBuilder class for listing workflow entities in Drupal, including methods for creating instances, building headers and rows for display, and rendering the list with handling for no available workflow types.

classes.name: WorkflowListBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds a list of workflow entities for display in Drupal's admin interface.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of WorkflowListBuilder using dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the WorkflowListBuilder with entity type, storage, and workflow type manager.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the form ID for the workflow admin overview.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header row for the workflow list table.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given workflow entity, including label, type, and states.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the workflow list, including handling the case when no workflow types are available.
